'''Tresalis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Tresalis was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] trained in the ways of [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]]. As a noted [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]], Tresalis created a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] which held her teachings on compassion, support, and a bedside manner. The holocron came to be known as the [[Mournful Holocron]] because of Tresalis' overwhelming sadness at the loss of a loved one. In order to access the holocron, a user had to first console its [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] and help the part of Tresalis imbued in the holocron cope with her loss.<ref name="SS" />
